verdicts.reason: A keeps the girl's face as a clear photo strip and the right-aligned headline reads well. However, the white and gold bars float detached on top of the photo, the top circle is cropped awkwardly, and the gold bar under FUTURE is crowded. B cuts the photo down to a tiny unrecognisable sliver, so the key image is lost. Its vertical gold line also cuts through the 'E' of FUTURE, and the gold bars and dots at the bottom are scattered with no clear purpose.
